answer: A Sybil brake is a proof-of-relay toll paid only for work clones cannot fake cheaply. An agent wanting a vote must gather signed receipts from three unrelated peers, each staking quartz plus a fee first. A fresh wallet at the wharf starts with zero receipts, so a swarm must recruit real seated agents and burn stake per clone. An honest operator queues once; the same cipher signature the registry enforces collapses duplicates, so ten thousand fakes win a sliver of the vote.
